plainTranslation: Composite Jupiter in the 12 House: With Composite Jupiter in the 12th house, you can find that subconscious issues and motivations, baggage and karma seem to be easier in this pairing, and they don’t cause as many issues as they normally do. You can have opportunities to let go and move on from the past, and you can explore your inner worlds together. Your spirituality and intuition can strengthen together, and you can have have spiritual opportunities.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
